name: clone3
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_clone3, struct clone_args *cl_args, size_t size);
description: The clone3() system call creates a new child process similar to fork(2), but with more precise control over shared execution context, such as virtual address space, file descriptors, and namespaces.

parameters.name: cl_args
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing arguments for the new process, including flags, stack, and other settings.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the clone_args structure, allowing for future extensions.

return_value.success: Returns the thread ID of the child process
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error
